senprior.label: the previous Senate race
senprior.source: Previous Senate race by county: Verified Voting 2020 official county results, and MIT Election Data and Science Lab files for 2022 and 2024 (see senate-and-governor-2026-vs-prior-race-by-county-2026-11-04.md).

notes.AK: Alaska reports presidential results by state House district, not by borough, so it has no county data here.
notes.CT: Connecticut is drawn on its eight historic counties, the codes the certified presidential file uses.
notes.KC: Kansas City, Missouri reports separately; its votes are added to Jackson County, though the city also reaches into Clay, Platte and Cass counties.
notes.VA: Falls Church city is added to Fairfax County and Bedford city (2016) to Bedford County.
